name: set_secondary_render_y_rotation_degrees

stack.evidence: func_001D63E0 reads the top stack value, converts it from degrees to radians, passes it to func_001007D0, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_001007D0 stores the angle in the Y component at offset 0x44 of secondary render transform D_0048DDA0[1]. The per-frame render path passes that transform through sceVu0RotMatrix and submits it as render view 1 when the secondary-view flag is active. The only JP call passes 90 during the al01.ard event sequence, after capture_screen and fade_captured_screen.
